About Us

Dawn service - 5 a.m

Seek ye first the kingdom Of God – every first day of the month , the church gathers together  to seek the Presence of the Lord for the new month.

Every first day of the month holds special significance for us as a church community. As the word says, “Seek ye first the kingdom of God,”  we seek the Kingdom Of God and presence and guidance of the Lord for the new month ahead. Through worship, prayer, and fellowship, these gatherings offer us an opportunity to draw closer to God, renew our faith, and set the tone for a spiritually fulfilling and blessed month. It happens every first Sunday of every month at 5 a.m

Join Dawn service

Prayer services

Night prayer - time:

The Night Prayer service

The Night Prayer service at our church is a deeply meaningful and reflective gathering that takes place every last Friday of the month, thanking the Lord for her mercy and GRace for the past month.

Advantages

Fasting prayer

 

Join us in seeking God through fasting and prayer. This special gathering is a time to humble ourselves, focus on God’s Word, and experience spiritual breakthroughs. Come prepared to worship, pray, and align your heart with His purposes.

 

Join Fasting prayer

7 Days of Prayer

A week-long journey dedicated to persistent prayer and spiritual renewal. Each day focuses on a different theme, helping participants deepen their relationship with God and intercede

Join 7 Days of Prayer

21 days of prayer

An extended season of prayer and fasting to experience sustained spiritual growth and transformation. This program is designed to strengthen faith, ignite purpose, and invite God’s presence into every area of life.

Join 21 days of prayer

Special sundays

Special Sundays at our church are joyous occasions that allow us to come together as a community and celebrate the diverse and meaningful aspects of our lives and faith. Each of these unique Sundays holds a special place in our hearts and offers us an opportunity to reflect, honor, and rejoice in various important themes and events.

For instance, Mother’s Day is a cherished day where we express our gratitude and love for all the wonderful mothers and mother figures in our congregation. We take this time to celebrate their unconditional love, sacrifices, and the invaluable role they play in nurturing and shaping our families and communities.

Valentine’s Day is another beautiful occasion where we celebrate the sacred bond of marriage and love. It’s a time to honor the commitment, companionship, and love shared between couples in our church. We celebrate the beauty of marriage as a divine union and a reflection of God’s love for us.

Women’s Day is a special Sunday dedicated to recognizing and honoring the incredible women in our church and society. We celebrate their strength, resilience, faith, and contributions to our community and the world. It’s a day to uplift and empower women, acknowledging their unique gifts and the vital role they play in our families, church, and broader society.

These are just some instances of our  Special Sundays  and these special Sundays are not only occasions of celebration but also moments of reflection and spiritual growth. They remind us of the importance of love, family, community, and faith in our lives.It’s a time for unity, celebration, and renewal as we continue to grow together in faith and love as a church family.

 

Join Special sundays

OUR MISSION STATEMENT

Transformation of Life by creating a hunger for prayer, word of God, worship and thereby producing Godly characters, Disciples and Good works

 – To reach and influence the world by building a Christ-centered, Bible-based church, changing mindsets and empowering people to lead and impact in every sphere of life.

Explore More

MISSIONS


We believe that God has called each of us as Christians to be missionaries here in the city of Chennai, reaching our colleagues, friends, family, and neighbors with the good news of Jesus. God also calls us to the “ends of the earth,” or to National and global missions.

A missional church

God also calls us to the “ends of the earth,” or to National and global missions.

ARK victory church is committed to helping Pastors who are in mission fields. Our desire is to help train, equip, pray, serve, and give financially to what God is already doing in our country.

Join Our Mission

-By Alan Hirsch

“A missional church is a community of God's people that defines itself, and organizes its life around, its real purpose of being an agent of God's mission to the world”.

Petras and Rakshak

ARK Victory church is integrated to Petras and Rakshak – two local missions of the Church.

purpose

Petras, founded in 2009, is a Christ-centered business unit of ARK Victory Church. It was formed with the purpose of building lives and raising resources for planting churches across the country.

OUR MINISTRY 

MINISTRY TEAMS

Another great way to get connected is to Volunteer at ARK Victory Church by joining one of our Ministry Teams – serving Jesus in and through practical ways at Church. We have incredible teams of people who serve on ministry teams, with the heart to make Jesus known and to serve each other through the offering of their gifts, time and talents. Ministry Teams are a great way to get involved, meet others within our church body and serve together at ARK Victory Church.

MINISTRY
TEAMS

Church Services​

We have four different services every Sunday

The highlight of our services is the vibrant Spirit-led worship, undiluted Word of God, and a family of loving people. We have four different services every Sunday. 

More About US

Church Services​

Hindi Church

We also have a Hindi service in the evening at 5 pm. The Hindi church is expanding, allowing brothers and sisters from north India to worship the Lord in unison in their own language.

Join Hindi Church

Telugu Church

The Telugu church connects together all our Telugu speaking brothers and sisters every Sunday at 5 p.m

Join TELUGU Church

Our Ark Church

Victory kids church

At Ark we believe children are an asset and not a liability.  Our dedicated team of teachers through creative methods that are child friendly impart the Word of God to the kids to lay strong biblical foundations . Victory kids cater to children from the age group of 3 years old to 12 years of age.

Join Victory kids

Tweens church

The children who feel they do not fit in Victory Kids yet feel they are too young for Ark Arise are part of the Tweens church. They are an energetic and enthusiastic bunch of teenagers that can be themselves and study the word of God. They meet every Sunday to read , study and understand the Word of God.

Join Tweens church

Ark arise

The target group of the church is the youngsters. There are various events like Sparkz, Life fests, Tribe night, Camps that happen yearly to draw  the youngsters to God. Ark arise is a  service that caters to these youngsters every Sunday.

Join Ark arise

Hindi church

The Hindi Church is growing, creating a space for brothers and sisters from North India to worship the Lord together in the beauty of their own language. Hindi Church happens every 5 pm.

Join Hindi Church

Telugu fellowship

Our church has a Telugu Fellowship, bringing together all our Telugu-speaking brothers and sisters every Sunday for worship, Word, and fellowship in their heart language. Telugu Fellowship happens every Sunday at 5 PM.

Telugu Fellowship

international Fellowship

The African Fellowship brings together brothers and sisters from across many nations, uniting hearts to worship the Lord together in one spirit and as one family. African fellowship happens every 2nd Sunday.

Join International

Rakshak

One little heartbeat at a time-

Rakshak is out NGO , founded in 2004, aiming to create an environment for underprivileged children in informal settlements. Over the 19 years, Rakshak has been able to serve 1000 plus children . Our children, by God’s grace have been placed in good positions and good jobs and some of them are in colleges. Our dream is to see the cycle of poverty broken in their life.

Our discipleship groups is a place where we pray together and study the word together and do life together and stand for each other. It is a nurturing place to grow in the Lord and to experience church being a family.

discipleship

The discipleship groups

Beyond the traditional Sunday services, our church works to create a sense of family through disciple group gatherings. These gatherings provide a space for intimate fellowship, where we collectively study into the enriching teachings of God’s word.  Our discipleship groups are a place where we pray together and study the word together and do life together and stand for each other. It is a nurturing place to grow in the Lord and to experience church being a family.

Join Didcipleship

Discipleship is the process of following and becoming more like Jesus and is the point of the Christian walk.

 To follow Jesus with immediate and complete obedience, make God first priority in life and follow Jesus with wholehearted commitment and singular focus.  

Discipleship cannot happen just on a Sundays. That is why we meet in smaller groups throughout the city during the week for fellowship and to dive deeper into the questions about Sunday sermons.  

Our Mission

Missions

 Our church is Mission focused. At present we are supporting seven missionaries. We stand with the vision of having one church in every district of India. We  conduct and coordinate blessing festivals, firmly believing in not only preaching the gospel but also demonstrating it in the community.

Evagelistic events

Church is more than walls — it is a family and a home.

For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.

– Matthew 18:20

At the Ark victory church, our journey is built on faith, love, and service. For over 21 years, we have been a family united in Christ, committed to spreading hope and compassion within our community and beyond.

From small gatherings in the early days to a vibrant congregation today, God’s grace has guided every step of our growth. Our mission is simple yet profound — to share the Gospel, uplift the broken-hearted, and stand as a place of healing, worship, and fellowship for all.

Join this Sunday

The ark victory Journey

1999 – Ministry Began

The Ark Ministry began with a small group of believers gathering in faith and prayer, sowing the seeds for what would later grow into a thriving church community.

 

2000–2003 – Rooftop Fellowship

Fellowship meetings were held on a rooftop, where people came together to worship, pray, and grow in God’s Word — laying the foundation for the church’s vision and mission.

 

2004 – New Mandate, New Beginning

  • January 2004: Church restarted with 5 people at Caspa Hall, under a fresh mandate from the Lord inspired by the book of Nehemiah.

Vision of Rakshak

  • God gave the vision of Rakshak.
  • It began under a tree with 20 children learning spoken English — with a cup of Boost and biscuits.
  • Today, Rakshak has impacted over 3,000 children, producing teachers, professionals, and leaders.

2006 – Camp Road Junction Hall

The ministry moved to Camp Road Junction Hall, marking a new phase of growth and community outreach.

 

2007 – Peace & Healing Festival

A powerful festival of faith and healing that reached many hearts, igniting revival and restoration.

 

2009 – Sparkz & Leadership Growth

A new focus on youth and leadership emerged, equipping the next generation to rise with purpose and vision.

 

October 2015 – The Ark Victory Church Building Dedicated

A new focus on youth and leadership emerged, equipping the next generation to rise with purpose and vision.

 The new Ark Victory Church building at Sembakkam was dedicated.

 

2020 - Tweens ministry began

A new focus on youth and leadership emerged, equipping the next generation to rise with purpose and vision.

 

2023 – Telugu Church Fellowship

The Telugu Church began, extending the vision to reach and serve diverse communities through worship and fellowship in their heart language.

The Ark Victory Church

Thanking god for 21 years of
goodnesss faithfulness |

For 21 years, The Ark Victory Church has been a beacon of faith, hope, and love. Together we have grown, prayed, and witnessed God’s mighty hand at work. This anniversary is not just a milestone, but a testimony of His grace and our unity as a family of believers.

Join this Sunday

Where church is Family

At The Ark Victory Church, we believe church is more than a place—it’s a family where you belong, grow, and thrive. Together we worship, learn, and live out God’s love to impact our city and beyond.

Join this Sunday

Welcome to The Ark Church Family

The Ark VCI is a passionate, word-based church in South Chennai, aiming to build God’s Kingdom through ministering to individuals and families. Our core value is to love God & love people unconditionally which gives the Ark a unique flavour. People of all age groups, languages, ethnicities, and cultures are welcome to our church. At Ark, every individual is encouraged and edified to grow in their calling and be a committed Disciple of Jesus Christ. The Ark VCI’s purpose is to glorify God by establishing a powerful local church, teaching “Transformation of life” through prayer, worship, and fellowship, resulting in Godly characters, disciples, and good works.

Know more about us

Together We Can Glorify God

Join us Online Every Sunday

Our 8:00 AM ( Tamil) and 10:00 AM (English)  services are streamed live online. Be part of uplifting worship, a life-changing Word, and the presence of God right where you are.

Watch on YouTube

Church is more than walls — it is a family and a home.

The bilingual service

6AM

TAMIL SERVICE

8 AM

ENGLISH SERVICE

10 AM

ARK ARISE

(YOUTH SERVICE)

12:15 PM

Church Services​

We have four different services every Sunday

The highlight of our services is the vibrant Spirit-led worship, undiluted Word of God, and a family of loving people. We have four different services every Sunday. 

More About US
Church Services​

Hindi Church

We also have a Hindi service in the evening at 5 pm. The Hindi church is expanding, allowing brothers and sisters from north India to worship the Lord in unison in their own language.

Join Hindi Church

Telugu Church

The Telugu church connects together all our Telugu speaking brothers and sisters every Sunday at 5 p.m

Join TELUGU Church

Our Ark Church

Victory kids church

At Ark we believe children are an asset and not a liability.  Our dedicated team of teachers through creative methods that are child friendly impart the Word of God to the kids to lay strong biblical foundations . Victory kids cater to children from the age group of 3 years old to 12 years of age.

Join Victory kids

Tweens church

The children who feel they do not fit in Victory Kids yet feel they are too young for Ark Arise are part of the Tweens church. They are an energetic and enthusiastic bunch of teenagers that can be themselves and study the word of God. They meet every Sunday to read , study and understand the Word of God.

Join Tweens church

Ark arise

The target group of the church is the youngsters. There are various events like Sparkz, Life fests, Tribe night, Camps that happen yearly to draw  the youngsters to God. Ark arise is a  service that caters to these youngsters every Sunday.

Join Ark arise

Growing Together in Faith

Hindi church

The Hindi Church is growing, creating a space for brothers and sisters from North India to worship the Lord together in the beauty of their own language. Hindi Church happens every 5 pm.

Join Hindi Church

Telugu fellowship

Our church has a Telugu Fellowship, bringing together all our Telugu-speaking brothers and sisters every Sunday for worship, Word, and fellowship in their heart language. Telugu Fellowship happens every Sunday at 5 PM.

Join Telugu Fellowship

international Fellowship

The African Fellowship brings together brothers and sisters from across many nations, uniting hearts to worship the Lord together in one spirit and as one family. African fellowship happens every 2nd Sunday.

Join International

Rakshak

One little heartbeat at a time-

Rakshak is out NGO , founded in 2004, aiming to create an environment for underprivileged children in informal settlements. Over the 19 years, Rakshak has been able to serve 1000 plus children . Our children, by God’s grace have been placed in good positions and good jobs and some of them are in colleges. Our dream is to see the cycle of poverty broken in their life.

Donate us

WHERE CHURCH IS FAMILY

Our core value is to love God & love people unconditionally which gives the Ark a unique flavour.  People of all age groups, languages, ethnicities, and cultures are welcome to our church. At Ark, every individual is encouraged and edified to grow in their calling and be a committed Disciple of Jesus Christ. The Ark VCI’s purpose is to glorify God by establishing a powerful local church, teaching “Transformation of life” through prayer, worship, and fellowship, resulting in Godly characters, disciples, and good works.

Join this Sunday

Love God Love people

The Ark Victory Church is a passionate, Word-based church in South Chennai with a heart to reach people and transform lives. We believe church is more than a place — it’s a family where people of all ages, backgrounds, and cultures can experience God’s love and grow together in faith.

Our mission is to glorify God by

Love

Loving God & Loving People unconditionally.

Worship

Honoring God through heartfelt praise, prayer, and thanksgiving.

Discipleship

Equipping people with God’s Word to grow in faith and live with purpose.

Service

Reaching out to communities with compassion, care, and practical support.

Join this Sunday

Preaching Hope, Inspiring Generations

Guided by faith, we inspire hearts and transform lives."

pastors

Our Church Pastors

PS.Jay kumar & PS. Anjali

“A good pastor is like a shepherd who leads his flock with love and compassion.” 

Our Ark Team Welcomes you.

WHERE CHURCH IS A FAMILY

Since you were precious in My sight, You have been honored, And I have loved you; Therefore I will give men for you, And people for your life.

The Ark Victory Church team consists of dedicated leaders who are committed to serving Christ and the Church. The church office is led by a group of passionate individuals who focus on various ministries, including worship, ministry services, outreach, and youth programs. They work to foster spiritual growth and provide support to church members.

Join this Sunday
